$comment: THE CANON AS LAW. canon.md explains it; this file is what the lint reads. Values are the ones the console already ships (style.css :root) unless marked debt. Changing a number here changes the rule everywhere.

type.note: There is no --fs-5; the jump 19 -> 27 is deliberate: one loud number, nothing between.
type.$comment: Raw font-size values outside the ramp are debt. The lint records them in canon_baseline.json.

space.note: 1px is hairlines, 2px/6px are chip and glyph nudges; everything else is on the 4px ladder. Spacing is ADVISORY: counted and reported, not yet gating.

radius.note: Pills (999px) and circles (50%) are shapes, not radii.

colour.rule: Colour is spent by role. A hex outside :root is debt; a role that is not a token is a defect.
colour.contrast: Every text token clears 4.5:1 on its surface (pinned by tests/test_status_tokens.py).
colour.severity_ramp: critical red -> high orange -> medium yellow -> low neutral; each token clears 4.5:1 on --surface-2; colour never travels alone

frame.header_per_view: title + count + exactly one primary verb
frame.ninth_primitive_needs: a written justification in this file

motion.rule: Motion marks a state change only; nothing animates on load, nothing bounces.

responsive.nav: scrollable rail; the primary surface never hides behind a hamburger
responsive.tables: at <=720 a table becomes stacked label/value rows; horizontal scroll is allowed only inside a designated data grid
responsive.sheets: full height at <=720; primary verb sticky in thumb reach
responsive.hover: a fact that exists only on hover is a defect on touch; every title= needs a tap equivalent or must be removed
responsive.open_on_desktop: allowed for bulk configuration, never for a primary action

touch.note: --btn-h is 28px on pointer devices and raised on touch; the audit measures the live result.

budgets.$comment: Row verbs are controls inside table rows; a dense view carries its weight in filters, not per-row buttons.
budgets.$comment_row_verbs: A row may carry no verb at rest. One disclosure per row may hold its verbs: the list stays a list, and every verb is still one click away on its own row.

hover_only.rule: Meaning may not live in a title attribute alone.
hover_only.measure: count of title= attributes in web/*.js and index.html; debt recorded in canon_baseline.json
